name: intro
heading: A clear path to a ready close
narration: This is Odin Close Control, an independent concept by Ayo Ahmed. On the public app, I'll take one fictional deal from a cash exception to a reviewed handoff.

name: commitments-upload
heading: 01 · Upload commitments
narration: First, I upload the commitments CSV: known synthetic accounts and exact amounts.

name: payments-upload
heading: 02 · Upload payment events
narration: Then the payment events CSV. I confirm that these are the supplied synthetic records and ask for a preview.

name: validated-preview
heading: Preview before saving
narration: The server shows commitment changes and new payment events before anything is saved. The preview is tied to this revision.

name: atomic-import
heading: Apply one atomic import
narration: I apply these validated files together. Either every change is saved, or none is.

name: cash-exception
heading: Keep the exception visible
narration: Aurora still has a two thousand pound receipt without an account. It stays outside matched cash until someone resolves it.

name: explicit-match
heading: Choose the exact account
narration: I choose Linden Ventures' commitment for this receipt, then explicitly confirm the match. That decision is recorded in the audit trail.

name: reconciled-cash
heading: Cash reconciled
narration: The cash shortfall is now zero. Principal and illustrative fees stay separate. Final legal evidence is still required.

name: legal-metadata
heading: Attach a final reference
narration: I attach the final synthetic legal metadata. It records a document reference and hash; it does not verify a real agreement.

name: ready-request
heading: Request human review
narration: The readiness checks are met. I request a human review of this saved revision.

name: human-review
heading: Review this exact snapshot
narration: The synthetic reviewer checks this exact snapshot and explicitly approves it. A relevant later change would clear that approval.

name: persisted-reload
heading: Reload the saved review
narration: I reload the public app. The approved revision is still present in the saved session.

name: packet-download
heading: Download the reviewed packet
narration: Now I download the actual packet JSON and cash ledger. The packet contains the approved revision and its snapshot hash.

name: handoff
heading: An inspectable human handoff
narration: This is a reviewed readiness handoff. It does not sign an agreement, close an investment, or move funds.
